<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="en" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
<category id="CAT1" name="trivial category">
<rule id="EXAMPLE_RULE" name="External rule to test">
<pattern><token>language</token><token>tool</token></pattern>
<message>first</message>
<example correction="">language tool</example>
</rule></category></rules>
